statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I25.10
The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The denial reason code is CO-97
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care
